guidance.headline: Start 21 now. The procedure text and the invoice description are built.
guidance.headline_sub: 20a (one procedure text per Procedure, exactly as received, the hospital's replacing the rooms' with the original in the History; an invoice description by the order of defaults that the office's edit always overrides, printed on the invoice; one procedure stack on every Booking screen, Admin Review and the List drawer; attachments removed; AR-35's illustrative wording seeded; every seeded figure unchanged) is done. The Contracts track continues with 21 (the payer, insurer or funder, and who is billed), then 21a to 25, in the ROADMAP's run order. Then the UI unification track starts (owner-added 12 November, docs/ui-unification/): U1 runs after 21, then U2 and U3 side by side in two worktrees, all before 21a; U4 and U5 after 22 and before 23; U6 after 25; U7 before 44.
guidance.parallel: Only 21 is next in the run order. After it comes U1 on its own, then U2 and U3 at the same time, each in its own git worktree and branch from the commit that holds 21 and U1; the one that finishes second merges both on branch ui/u2-u3, and the owner takes that into master before 21a starts. No other UI unification phase runs beside another phase: they edit the same shared files. 17a and 26 have their catch-up dependencies met but come after the Contracts track and U6 in the run order, so run 21 on its own.
